SyncShard.title: SyncShard
SyncShard.description: Sharded real-time operational state document synchronized across Centrale Operativa and Volunteer terminals via Cloud Firestore.

shardId.description: Fixed shard identifier (mission, volontari, servizi, turni, bacheca, magazzino, timbrature, indirizzi, checklists, config)

version.description: Monotonic numeric revision counter incremented on shard updates

payload.description: Native Firestore Map containing domain state fields for this shard

updatedByUid.description: Firebase UID of the verified user who last wrote this shard

updatedByEmail.description: Verified email of the operator who last updated this shard

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set on shard creation

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set on every update

AdminEntry.title: AdminEntry
AdminEntry.description: Administrator authorization record granting full Centrale Operativa Cloud Sync governance.

OperatorEntry.title: OperatorEntry
OperatorEntry.description: Approved Croce Oro operator or vehicle terminal account authorized to read and write operational sync shards.

OperatorRequest.title: OperatorRequest
OperatorRequest.description: Self-submitted access request created by a verified Google user awaiting Centrale Admin approval.

PinResetTicket.title: PinResetTicket
PinResetTicket.description: Zero-PII one-time PIN reset ticket allowing an unauthenticated volunteer with a valid secret token and provisional PIN to define their personal 4-digit access PIN without requiring a Google account.

tokenId.description: High-entropy one-time reset token matching the document ID

volunteerId.description: Internal volunteer identifier in the volunteers shard

displayName.description: First and last name shown on the PIN activation screen (zero PII: no email/phone/CF)

pinProvvisorio.description: 4-digit provisional verification PIN issued by the administrator

pinProvvisorioVerifica.description: Placeholder '----' on creation; matching 4-digit provisional PIN submitted by the volunteer during activation

nuovoPin.description: Empty on creation, set to 4-digit personal PIN (not 4451) upon completion

PinResetProfile.title: PinResetProfile
PinResetProfile.description: Zero-PII SHA-256 verification index per volunteer enabling in-app PIN reset without Google Sign-In or any PII exposure.

emailHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of normalized volunteer email (empty if absent)

pinHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of volunteerId and current/provisional 4-digit PIN

verifyingProofHash.description: Placeholder '----' on operator sync; matching SHA-256 proof digest submitted on unauthenticated reset

nuovoPin.description: Empty unless completed; new 4-digit personal PIN (never 4451)

ShiftSignup.title: ShiftSignup
ShiftSignup.description: Zero-PII volunteer shift sign-up submission persisted without requiring Google Sign-In and reconciled into sync_shards/turni by Centrale Operativa.

RadioSlot.title: RadioSlot
RadioSlot.description: Ultra-low-latency ring-buffer slot document for real-time walkie-talkie voice audio, PTT signaling, and instant missed-call catch-up across devices and networks.

payload.description: Native Firestore Map containing compressed ADPCM24 voice frames or live PTT/emergency state

sentAtMs.description: Sender millisecond timestamp for ordering and freshness diagnostics

PushSubscriptionEntry.title: PushSubscriptionEntry
PushSubscriptionEntry.description: Zero-PII Web Push endpoint routing record enabling cross-origin background wake alerts for radio and emergency calls.

PublicRoster.title: PublicRoster
PublicRoster.description: Zero-PII volunteer login directory (single whitelisted document volunteers_v1) enabling newly installed volunteer smartphones to display all active volunteer names and verify 4-digit PINs via SHA-256 digests without exposing any PII (no email, phone, tax ID, address, documents, signatures, or plaintext PIN).

version.description: Monotonic revision counter incremented on every roster publication

entries.description: Bounded list (max 400) of zero-PII volunteer login cards (id, nome, cognome, qualifica, SHA-256 pinHash, boolean hasFirma/pinIsEmergency/approvato/profiloCentrale)

deletedIds.description: Bounded list (max 300) of explicitly deleted volunteer IDs

PublicBoard.title: PublicBoard
PublicBoard.description: Zero-PII published weekly shift schedule board (single whitelisted document shifts_v1) enabling Monitor Mode PCs (no login) and volunteer devices without Google Auth to display every published shift across all territorial sections in real time.

version.description: Monotonic revision counter incremented on every board publication

turni.description: Bounded list (max 1500) of zero-PII published shift cards (schedule, section, shift type, vehicle, crew display names only)

sedi.description: Bounded list (max 60) of zero-PII territorial section definitions (id, nome, mezziAssegnati)

PublicRaspberryBoard.title: PublicRaspberryBoard
PublicRaspberryBoard.description: Zero-PII published Raspberry Pi section display board (single whitelisted document display_v1) exposing central association notices, section notices, active/exited shift badge timestamps (display names only, zero PII), and display configuration for unattended Raspberry Pi kiosks without login.

version.description: Monotonic revision counter incremented on every Raspberry board publication

sedi.description: Bounded list (max 60) of zero-PII territorial section definitions

bacheca.description: Bounded list (max 150) of zero-PII association and section notice cards

timbrature.description: Bounded list (max 350) of zero-PII active and recent exited shift badge records (display name, role, entry/exit timestamps, section only)

config.description: Display preferences configured by Admin, President, or Secretary

/sync_shards/{shardId}.description: Domain-partitioned operational sync shards for missions, volunteers, shifts, vehicles warehouse, logs, addresses, and checklists.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Elevated admin identities allowed to manage operators and delete shards.

/operators/{operatorUid}.description: Verified operators approved by Admin to participate in live multi-device Firestore sync.

/operator_requests/{requestUid}.description: Access request queue from Google-authenticated devices pending Admin approval.

/pin_resets/{tokenId}.description: Zero-PII token-gated one-time PIN reset tickets accessible without Google Auth.

/pin_reset_profiles/{volunteerId}.description: Zero-PII SHA-256 write-only blind verification profiles enabling unauthenticated in-app PIN reset.

/shift_signups/{signupId}.description: Zero-PII volunteer shift sign-up queue accessible without Google Auth.

/radio_slots/{slotId}.description: Fixed 14-document ring buffer for ultra-low-latency walkie-talkie voice frames, PTT state, and last transmission catch-up.

/push_subscriptions/{subId}.description: Zero-PII Web Push subscriptions for background wake alerts across Vercel and Cloud Run.

/public_roster/{rosterId}.description: Zero-PII volunteer login roster (single document volunteers_v1) allowing newly installed devices to load all volunteer names without exposing PII.

/public_board/{boardId}.description: Zero-PII published shift schedule board (single document shifts_v1) for Monitor Mode and volunteer shift boards.

/public_raspberry/{boardId}.description: Zero-PII published Raspberry Pi section display board (single document display_v1) for association notices, section notices, and badge presence/exit timestamps.
